name: Dayshift at Freddy's 2: Electric Boogaloo
source:
"Hi, welcome back to Freddy Fazbender's Pizza! W-Wait... A-Aren't the police after you?! What are you DOING HERE?! 
"Uh, whatever! We need staff, alright? Things haven't been easy for us since what happened in Colorado...and Arizona...And Reno...A-

"We can depend on YOU to look after things, right? 1987 is almost over, and nobody has been bitten...yet...
We need you to make sure the place stays open and the company isn't destroyed forever. This is our last chance, employee..."

The sequel to the parody game Dayshift at FNAF.
translation:
“嗨，欢迎回到弗雷迪·法兹熊披萨店！等等……警察不是在追捕你吗？！你在这里干什么？！”
“呃，算了！我们需要员工，明白吗？自从科罗拉多……亚利桑那……还有里诺发生那件事以来，我们的日子一直不好过……”

“我们可以指望你照看好这里，对吧？1987年快结束了，目前还没有人被咬……暂时没有……
我们需要你确保店铺继续营业，公司不会永远毁灭。这是员工最后的机会……”

恶搞游戏《Dayshift at FNAF》的续作。
